method: I searched online for visual references related to movement, transparency, pixel art, product structure, and interactive websites. I then organised these references into a MoodBoard page using HTML and CSS. I experimented with grids, cards, image sizes, colours, spacing, and typography.
related_work: The reading on creative internet platforms helped me understand how online images, communities, and digital platforms can shape inspiration.
conclusion_future_work: This week helped me understand that visual research is not only about collecting images, but also about finding ideas that can influence design decisions. I still have limited experience with coding and interactive design, but I am becoming more confident through practice.
results_discussion: The result is a MoodBoard page that collects different visual ideas for my headphone project. Some references show objects becoming simpler and more abstract, while others use transparency to reveal hidden structures. I was also interested in animation, repeated layers, digital overlays, and pixel-style interfaces. These references helped me think about how the headphones could separate into different components and how information could appear around them.
title: creative-tech week 2
introduction: This week, I explored how digital tools and visual references can help me develop ideas for my headphone project. I focused on Html, Css, and collecting images for my moodboard.
